speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe when the swelling and pain in your right ring finger started and if there was any specific injury or insect bite that preceded it?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Did you notice any immediate deformity, such as the finger bending backwards at the distal joint, or an inability to actively straighten the tip of the finger? 
REQUEST TEST: X-Ray_Right_Hand

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: No bone fractures or dislocations visible. Soft tissue swelling noted around the distal interphalangeal joint of the right ring finger.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Do you have difficulty actively extending the tip of the finger, or does it feel like a spring-loaded mechanism that straightens with a snap? 
Can you voluntarily flex and extend the distal interphalangeal joint against resistance?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Your inability to flex the fingertip despite a negative X-ray is classic for a distal flexor tendon avulsion, often called a "Jersey Finger."

DIAGNOSIS READY: Jersey Finger

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
